sentences.text: In the quiet depths of the house, something began to stir around 05:40, as the machines started waking up.
Between 05:40 and 05:50, the appliances registered an immense burst of energy, totaling 340 Wh.
This recorded spike was wildly outside the expected range of "44 Wh to 88 Wh".
It seems a mischievous entity decided to bring the house's power system to life during this brief window.
